role: The redstone lamp (123) and lit lamp (124): turns on when powered and off 4 ticks after power leaves; both drop the unlit lamp.
scope_reason: world.conf redstone = off: the oracle's World.isBlockProvidingPowerTo and getIndirectPowerLevelTo return 0, so no block ever receives power (SPEC Decisions, unsupported features are world switches). The lamp (123) only lights from power, so it is a plain block; the lit lamp (124) cannot be obtained.

members.name: onNeighborBlockChange
members.note: power checks; the unlit lamp does nothing without power

missing: An unpowered lit lamp going dark (onBlockAdded's 4-tick schedule and updateTick setting redstone_lamp) is not native; with redstone off Java does it four ticks after a lit lamp is set (seen while recording pickblock-s1).
notes: A lit lamp placed by a dev op would schedule its 4-tick turn-off in the oracle; native has no case for that (not a reachable survival state).
